props.title: Quadrasonic
props.face: A four-piece rock band from the Vail Valley.
props.lede: You know what happens when the opening riff of Zombie or Mr. Brightside comes on at a wedding. Quadrasonic is a hard-hitting rock band with a powerhouse singer out front, playing the songs your guests grew up on, from Pat Benatar and Blondie to No Doubt, Nirvana and Paramore. This is the band to book when you want a rock show and a dance floor at the same time.
props.headingNote: Here’s how booking through Signet works.

props.title: Quadrasonic playing Hit Me With Your Best Shot live

props.html: Quadrasonic plays rock from the ’70s to today, and a lot of their song list comes from ’90s alternative radio. You’ll hear Heart and Joan Jett next to Hole, Veruca Salt and Garbage, and newer songs from Paramore and Chappell Roan, too. They also play a few pop hits, like Toxic and Levitating, with the guitars turned up.

Their singer can go from a grunge growl to soaring high notes, and she’s been on stage her whole life, so she brings a little theater to every show. She plays hundreds of shows a year around Colorado.
The band is based in the Vail Valley, and they play weddings, festivals, summer concert series and clubs across Colorado, including the GoPro Mountain Games in Vail.

props.title: Configurations
props.note: Send us your date and we’ll let you know what Quadrasonic would need at your venue.

rows.text: If you’re getting married in Vail or Beaver Creek, a band that already lives in the valley is a great fit for your reception. They’re a great choice when you and your friends grew up on No Doubt and Nirvana.
For a 40th or a 50th where everyone grew up on ’90s radio, Quadrasonic is a lot of fun.
After a conference or a holiday dinner, a loud, fun rock band is an easy way to get a whole company on the dance floor.
If your team is meeting in Vail, a band from the valley is an easy choice for your closing party.

props.html: Planning toasts or a program? We can work the music around them with your run of show. You can also get a general idea of what live music costs in Colorado from our cost guide.
